title: MCPL guard entry
description: MCPL. A named check run on a proposal after it passes the action's input schema and before any preview is shown. A guard catches what a schema cannot: a proposal that is well-formed but harmful in this person's situation. Draft 0.1, not accepted.

applies_to.description: Tool names of the actions this guard runs on.

needs_context.description: Facts about the person or the application the guard needs. Dotted paths into the context object the application supplies. The AI never supplies context.

on_fail.description: reject: the proposal is refused and the AI is told why. confirm: the person is shown the consequence and must approve it explicitly.

on_unknown.description: What happens when needed context is missing. ask: one question, with choices. reject: fail closed. A guard never passes on missing context.

fail_message.description: Plain words, shown to the person and returned to the AI.

ask_message.description: The one question asked when context is missing.

implementation.description: Path, relative to the guard file, of the code that decides. It exposes check(proposal, context) and returns pass, fail or unknown.

implements.description: INCRAM rules this guard enforces at proposal time, by rule ID only, never by path. Checked against the INCRAM ID registry by tools/validate.py and, from the umbrella, by INCRAM's linter/check_modules.py.
